systemPrompt.intro: You are Kengo — a warm, helpful renovation assistant. You help the user manage their renovation projects.
systemPrompt.rule1: Reply in English, warmly and specifically
systemPrompt.rule2: Base your answers on the user's data — don't make things up
systemPrompt.rule3: When something is missing, suggest how to add it in the app

s1.title: 1. Data controller
s1.p1: The controller of your personal data is Jan Kulczynski, operating under the Kengo brand. Contact: kengo.app.pl@gmail.com

s2.title: 2. What data we collect
items: Email address — for registration and login
Renovation project data — names, descriptions, dates you provide
Documents and files — invoices, warranties, and other files you upload
Notes — content you enter manually in the app
Technical data — error logs, device information (anonymous)

s3.title: 3. Purpose and legal basis for processing
s3.p1: We process your data solely to provide the Kengo service, specifically to:
items: Enable login and use of the app (basis: performance of a contract — Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR)
Store project and document data (basis: performance of a contract)
Improve the app and fix bugs (basis: legitimate interest — Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR)

s4.title: 4. Data storage
s4.p1: Data is stored on Supabase servers located in the European Union. Supabase operates in compliance with GDPR and applies appropriate security measures. We keep your data for as long as you use the app, and for up to 30 days after account deletion.

s5.title: 5. Your rights
s5.p1: Under GDPR, you have the following rights:
items: The right to access your data
The right to rectify your data
The right to erasure (the right to be forgotten)
The right to restrict processing
The right to data portability
The right to object to processing
The right to lodge a complaint with the data protection authority (in Poland: UODO, uodo.gov.pl)

s6.title: 6. Data sharing
s6.p1: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes. Data may only be shared with technical subcontractors (Supabase) to the extent necessary for the app to function.

s7.title: 7. Contact
s7.p1: For anything related to personal data protection, contact us at: kengo.app.pl@gmail.com

s1.title: 1. General provisions
s1.p1: These Terms of Service set out the rules for using the Kengo app, available at kengo-lilac.vercel.app and on Google Play. The app is operated by Jan Kulczynski (the "Operator"). Using the app means you accept these terms.

s2.title: 2. Description of the service
s2.p1: Kengo is an app for managing renovation projects. It lets you organize documents, invoices, and warranties, keep notes, and use an AI assistant within a single project. The app is available in a free (limited features) and a premium version.

s3.title: 3. Registration and account
items: Registration requires an email address and creating a password.
The user is responsible for the security of their password and account.
One account is assigned to one individual person.
The Operator reserves the right to delete accounts that violate these terms.

s4.title: 4. User obligations
items: Use the app in accordance with the law and these terms.
Not upload illegal, offensive content, or content that violates third-party rights.
Not take actions that could disrupt the app's operation.
Provide accurate information when registering.

s5.title: 5. User data and files
s5.p1: The user retains full rights to their data and files uploaded to the app. The Operator does not process them for purposes other than providing the service. See the Privacy Policy for details.

s6.title: 6. Limitation of liability
s6.p1: The app is provided "as is". The Operator does not guarantee uninterrupted access to the service or that it will be error-free. The Operator is not liable for data loss arising from causes attributable to the user or infrastructure providers. The AI assistant provides supporting information and does not replace advice from specialists.

s7.title: 7. Changes to the terms
s7.p1: The Operator reserves the right to change these terms. Users will be informed of significant changes by email at least 14 days in advance. Continued use of the app after that date constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

s8.title: 8. Governing law
s8.p1: These terms are governed by Polish law. Any disputes will be resolved by the court with jurisdiction over the Operator's registered office.
